title: project name: rename bazel root package and final binary before publishing
body:
Change the project name, bazel package and final assembler binary to a choice between:

Possible targets:
- `//fasm:fasm-as`
- `//fasm:as`
- `//fpga:as`
- `//fpga:assembler`
- `//fasm-as`, with `//fasm/...` or `//fpga/....`
- `//fasmas`
author: lromor
